summary: Better forms, ownership rules and a small human triage rotation may outperform an LLM layer when request volume is modest or domain risk is high.

points.text: A proxy can make low-quality demand look orderly without resolving missing product decisions or conflicting stakeholder goals.
Automated duplicate detection tends to struggle when two requests share vocabulary but differ in user segment, failure mode or desired outcome.
Adding a conversational gate may frustrate requesters and reduce reporting of small but important defects.
